transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. What brings you here today?

Well, my supervisor kind of pushed me to come in. I work on a production line, and... I just keep leaving my station. Or I'll pop up out of my seat during shift meetings when I'm supposed to be staying put. My boss says it's becoming a real safety problem now, because I just take off and walk away before I even think about it.
Have you ever had trouble staying seated or felt the need to get up and move around in situations where others expect you to stay still, like at home, in meetings, or during meals?

Yeah, that's exactly what I was just saying about work. The whole reason I'm here is because I just keep leaving my station, or popping up out of my chair in those shift meetings. 

I know I'm supposed to stay put, but I just... I take off and walk away before I even think about it. My supervisor is the one who said it's becoming a real safety problem on the floor. But yeah, it's not just at the plant. If I'm at home trying to eat dinner or something, I'm always getting up and walking around, too. I just can't seem to stay in one spot.
